cases.d: The Secretary records the room with the room mic, or uploads a file, with consent, and gets a transcript.
steps: Open tab "Bản ghi" of an in-person meeting during the meeting.
In the mic card click "Bật mic phòng"; in "Bắt đầu ghi âm" enter Mục đích ghi âm "Lập biên bản cuộc họp", tick the statement that participants were told and click "Bắt đầu ghi".
Speak for a while, then click "Tắt mic, lưu lượt ghi".
Switch the mic on and off again for a second take.
Or click "Tải tệp lên", choose an audio file and confirm "Tải lên" in "Lưu tệp ghi âm".
Open "Nghe và xem bản gỡ băng".
exp: While recording the card shows "Đang ghi cả phòng" and the list shows "Mic phòng đang ghi" to everyone.
Switching off shows "Đã lưu lượt ghi."; the recording shows Mic phòng and "Đang chuyển chữ".
The second take needs no new consent and is appended to the same recording, which is transcribed again.
An uploaded file shows Tải lên.
When done it shows "Có bản gỡ băng"; the transcript lists speakers and times.
Without ticking consent the mic cannot start; an Online meeting has no room mic.
pre: An InProgress in-person meeting; signed in as its Secretary; microphone allowed; speech worker running.

cases.d: The Secretary corrects the transcript and names speakers; members only listen.
steps: In the transcript click "Sửa đoạn này", change the text and Lưu.
Assign "Người nói 1" to a participant.
As thanhvien, open the same transcript.
exp: "Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng." and "Đã gán người nói." appear.
thanhvien can listen and read but has no edit actions.
pre: A recording with a completed transcript.

cases.d: Delete a recording; the audio and transcript are erased.
steps: Click "Xoá bản ghi" and confirm.
exp: "Xoá bản ghi?" is asked first.
"Đã xoá bản ghi." appears; the recording leaves the tab and can no longer be played; its audio and transcript are erased.
pre: A stored recording; signed in as the Secretary.

cases.d: In an online meeting each participant's microphone turns their sentences into text and audio.
steps: Join the room of an InProgress Online meeting and turn the microphone on.
Say a sentence and pause.
Open "Ghi âm của tôi" and play the sentence back ("Nghe lại").
Click "Xoá câu này" and confirm "Xoá câu".
exp: The room shows "Cuộc họp được ghi âm để lập biên bản · tự xoá sau 180 ngày" and "Đang ghi lời bạn".
Each sentence appears as text under "Micro của <name>" in tab "Bản ghi" and can be heard back.
Deleting shows "Đã xoá câu nói." and the sentence and its audio leave the meeting.
pre: An InProgress Online (or Hybrid) meeting; signed in as a participant; microphone allowed; speech worker running.

cases.d: The Secretary deletes one take of the room recording.
steps: Open the transcript of a room recording with several takes.
On one take click "Xoá lượt này" and confirm "Xoá lượt".
exp: The dialog warns the take's sound and words are removed for good.
"Đã xoá lượt ghi." appears; the take's lines leave the transcript, later lines move up, corrected text and assigned names stay.
With only one take left, deleting it is refused: delete the whole recording instead.
pre: A room recording with at least two takes and a completed transcript; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: The Chair or Secretary saves the recording and the transcript to the computer.
steps: On a recording click "Tải tệp ghi âm".
In the transcript click "Tải bản gỡ băng (.txt)".
For an Online meeting click "Tải lời thoại (.txt)".
Sign in as thanhvien and open the same meeting.
exp: The original audio file and a text transcript with names and times are downloaded.
The per-microphone text leaves out sentences taken out of the record.
thanhvien sees no download buttons.
For a Mật meeting nobody can download.
pre: An Internal meeting with a transcribed recording; signed in as chutoa or thuky.

cases.d: The Chair or Secretary takes a sentence out of the record and puts it back.
steps: In tab "Bản ghi" of an Online meeting, on a sentence click "Bỏ khỏi biên bản".
Sign in as thanhvien and look at the same sentence.
As the Chair click "Khôi phục".
exp: "Đã loại câu khỏi bản ghi." appears; the Chair still sees the words marked as left out.
thanhvien sees "Câu đã được bỏ khỏi biên bản." without the words or audio.
Restoring shows "Đã đưa câu trở lại bản ghi.".
A quieter copy of another person's sentence is highlighted as possibly theirs.
pre: An Online meeting with stored sentences; signed in as chutoa.
